summary: Frontend-only, open-to-anyone chat-style Email Writing Assistant chatbot that detects email-writing intent, guides users through email-type-specific questions, generates polished emails from templates, and supports iterative refinements while remembering conversation context.
architectural_notes: Templates and conversation logic stored and executed in the frontend.
Support multiple template variants per email type (defaults unchanged; variants selectable/usable by generator).

existing_features.title: Implement a full chat-style messaging interface for an Email Writing Assistant, accessible immediately with no login required.

Detect when the user intends to write an email using keyword/trigger matching (at minimum: "email", "write", "draft", "help me email" plus type-specific triggers provided), and route the conversation into the email-writing flow when detected.

Present an email type selection menu in the chat UI that includes: Job application, Meeting request, Leave/time off, Follow-up, Thank you, Complaint/feedback, Introduction, Resignation, Apology, Invitation, Congratulations, Decline offer, and Custom.

For each email type, implement a guided, multi-turn question flow that collects the relevant details (at minimum: who it is for, purpose, and formal vs casual tone; plus type-specific details such as dates, names, reasons, position/company/qualifications, etc.).

Generate a complete email draft from collected inputs using templates customized with user-provided details, including: professional subject line, proper greeting, clear concise body, appropriate closing, and placeholders for missing user personal details (e.g., name/phone/email) when not provided.

After generating a draft, offer iterative refinement actions in-chat: adjust tone (more formal/casual), make it shorter/longer, change specific parts, and generate an alternative version; apply the selected refinement and return an updated draft without restarting the entire flow.

Maintain in-session conversation context so the bot does not re-ask questions that have already been answered, and allow the user to correct/update previously provided details when they mention changes.
Ensure the application is frontend-only: do not persist templates, user inputs, or conversation history to the Motoko backend; no backend calls are required for core functionality.
Apply a consistent, creative visual theme across the UI (colors, typography, spacing, and components) suitable for a writing assistant; avoid blue-and-purple as the primary palette.
Add the required generated images to the frontend as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in the UI (e.g., bot avatar and subtle background).

Add the user-provided Follow-up, Thank You, and Complaint/Feedback email drafts as additional template variants (not replacements) while keeping the current templates as the default output for each of these email types.

Update the 'Generate alternative' refinement behavior so that, for Follow-up, Thank You, and Complaint/Feedback email types, it can produce an alternative draft by selecting an added variant (when available) rather than regenerating the same default template.

new_feature_requests.summary: Chat-style messaging UI for the Email Writing Assistant (full chat interface)
Detect when user wants to write an email using keyword/intent triggers (e.g., email/write/draft/help me email + type-specific triggers)

Show a menu of email types (job application, meeting request, leave/time off, follow-up, thank you, complaint/feedback, introduction, resignation, apology, invitation, congratulations, decline offer, custom)
For each email type, ask relevant guided questions (recipient, purpose, tone, dates/names/details, etc.)
Generate an email with subject line, greeting, clear body, closing, and placeholders for user details
Post-generation refinement options: adjust tone, shorten/lengthen, edit specific parts, generate alternative version
Remember conversation context within the session to avoid re-asking answered questions
Use templates for common email types and customize output based on user inputs
Add additional template variants for Follow-up, Thank You, and Complaint/Feedback email types (keep existing defaults/triggers unchanged)
